description: The firewall's neighbour tables, ARP for IPv4 and NDP for IPv6: a MAC, an address and the interface each neighbour was learned on. On a firewall whose DHCP is unreadable they are the only client identity there is; the kind runs the client identity cascade at the MAC level on what they report, never makes this firewall a client, and never makes a neighbour of an upstream interface one.

cadences.basis: The neighbour tables were read at every lease pass before they became a kind of their own, and the lease cadence is kept: survey, data source 4, "Sustainable polling frequency" -- identities change on the scale of minutes to hours, and both tables are small.

functions.description: Called at every probe round: asks the firewall whether this implementation can be read.
functions.name: probe

functions.description: Called at every neighbour pass: every neighbour the tables hold now.
functions.name: neighbours
